newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Alfa upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's Alfa upgraded.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said Thursday it had raised its rating on Mexican conglomerate Grupo Industrial Alfa SA to buy from hold.

-- "We continue to believe that quarter-on-quarter EBITDA (earnings before income tax, depreciation and amortization) growth should be about flat" in the second half of 1996, analyst Terry Sigler wrote in a report.

-- "However, a more optimistic growth outlook for FY97, an aggressive capital expenditure program, and a low relative valuation should enable Alfa to regain its lost momentum going forward, in our opinion."
-- The company's shares closed at 38.40 pesos in Mexico City on Wednesday.
